# Dr. Shreyank Educare

> Expert academic tutoring in Math, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Coding, and Finance for students in Burnaby, Vancouver, and across Canada — offered in-person and online.

Dr. Shreyank Educare is a tutoring centre founded and led by Dr. Shreyank Gupta, a PhD-qualified educator with over 10 years of teaching experience. The centre specialises in concept-based, personalised learning for high school and university students, with a focus on building strong academic foundations rather than rote memorisation. It serves students across Burnaby, Vancouver, Metrotown, Delta, New Westminster, Richmond, Surrey, and nearby communities.

- Founded: 6th January, 2025
- Location: Burnaby, British Columbia, Canada
- Areas Served: Burnaby, Vancouver, Metrotown, Delta, New Westminster, Richmond, Surrey, and surrounding communities (in-person & online across Canada)
- Website: https://www.drshreyankeducare.com/

## About

- [About Us](https://www.drshreyankeducare.com/about): Background on the centre, teaching philosophy, learning process, and tutor profiles.

Dr. Shreyank (Founder & Lead Instructor) holds a PhD in Ultrasound Signal & Image Processing and has supported students from top Canadian universities including McGill, York, Carleton, and the University of Ottawa. The team also includes Prashanth Karupothula (Mechanical Engineering), Zeba Shaikh (Biology), Dr. Vandani Verma (Mathematics), Aanchal Kanotra, Dr. Vishal Sehgal, and Sabiha Arshed (MD, MSc).

The teaching approach follows a four-step process: Analysis (diagnosing weak areas), Concepts (building foundational understanding), Application (solving real-world problems), and Tracking (continuous progress monitoring).

## Programs

- [Programs Overview](https://www.drshreyankeducare.com/programs): Full list of academic subjects and course categories.

### Academic Subjects (High School)

- [Mathematics Tutoring](https://www.drshreyankeducare.com/programs/mathematics): Grades 6–12, Pre-Calculus 11 & 12, Calculus, Algebra, Trigonometry, word problems, and exam preparation.
- [Physics Tutoring](https://www.drshreyankeducare.com/programs/physics): Forces and motion, energy, electricity, waves, and university-level physics.
- [Chemistry Tutoring](https://www.drshreyankeducare.com/programs/chemistry): Chemical reactions, stoichiometry, acids and bases, organic chemistry, IB/AP support.
- [Biology Tutoring](https://www.drshreyankeducare.com/programs/biology): Human physiology, genetics, cell biology; suited for school exams and medical entrance prep.
- [Computer Science / Coding Tutoring](https://www.drshreyankeducare.com/programs/computer-science): Beginner coding, Python, logic building, robotics, STEM projects.

### Coding & Tech

- [Python Programming](https://www.drshreyankeducare.com/programs/python): Variables, loops, functions, logic building, debugging; 3 progressive levels from basics to an AI-powered chatbot capstone project. For kids and beginners.
- [JavaScript Programming](https://www.drshreyankeducare.com/programs/javascript): Variables, functions, DOM manipulation, OOP, and web interactivity; 3 levels from a simple calculator to a full student management web app.

### Test Preparation

- [SAT / PSAT Prep](https://www.drshreyankeducare.com/programs/sat-prep): SAT Math, evidence-based reading, writing & grammar, time management, adaptive practice tests. Target score: 1350–1550+.
- [MCAT Prep](https://www.drshreyankeducare.com/programs/mcat-prep): Biology & biochemistry, chemistry & physics, psychology & sociology, CARS strategy, full-length AAMC practice testing. Target score: 510–520+.
- [GRE Prep](https://www.drshreyankeducare.com/programs/gre-prep): Quantitative reasoning, verbal reasoning, vocabulary, analytical writing, mock testing. Target score: 320–335+.
- [GMAT Prep](https://www.drshreyankeducare.com/programs/gmat-prep): Quantitative reasoning, verbal reasoning, data insights, critical reasoning, adaptive exam strategy. Target score: 675–750+.

### University Courses

- [University Mathematics](https://www.drshreyankeducare.com/programs/university-mathematics): Calculus I & II, linear algebra, differential equations, statistics, probability, applied mathematics. Supports UBC and Langara courses.
- [University Physics](https://www.drshreyankeducare.com/programs/university-physics): Mechanics, thermodynamics, electromagnetism, waves, quantum and nuclear physics. Supports UBC and Langara courses.
- [University Chemistry](https://www.drshreyankeducare.com/programs/university-chemistry): Organic, inorganic, and physical chemistry, stoichiometry, reaction kinetics, lab report support. Supports UBC and Langara courses.
- [University Biology](https://www.drshreyankeducare.com/programs/university-biology): Cell biology, genetics, anatomy & physiology, ecology, evolution, exam preparation.
- [University Finance](https://www.drshreyankeducare.com/programs/university-finance): Financial basics, business concepts, and practical application for commerce students.

### Languages (Extra Curricular)

- [Mandarin](https://www.drshreyankeducare.com/programs/mandarin): Pronunciation and tonal accuracy, conversational Mandarin, character recognition, listening comprehension, vocabulary and sentence formation. For kids, adults, and career learners.
- [French](https://www.drshreyankeducare.com/programs/french): Speaking, grammar, reading, writing, vocabulary, conversational French, and proficiency exam preparation. For school students, adults, and professionals.

## Services

- [Services](https://www.drshreyankeducare.com/services): Details on tutoring delivery formats.

One-on-One Tutoring — Fully personalised sessions with flexible scheduling and a custom learning plan. Best for targeted improvement.

Small Group Classes — Weekly structured sessions with 6–8 students; encourages peer motivation at an affordable price point.

Exam Preparation (Exam Booster) — Intensive 2-week programs covering past papers, test-taking strategy, and IB/AP specialisation.

## Pricing
 
- [Pricing](https://www.drshreyankeducare.com/pricing): Transparent pricing across all program types.
 
Monthly Program — $185–$200/month
Best for consistent growth. Includes 2 sessions per week in a small group of 6–8 students, monthly progress tracking, and exam strategy support. No hidden fees.
 
1-on-1 Tutoring — $75–$100/session
Maximum personalisation. Fully customised sessions with flexible scheduling and a tailored learning plan. Price varies by subject and level.
 
Exam Booster — $280/course
Intensive exam preparation over 2 weeks. Covers past paper practice, test-taking strategy, and specialised support for IB and AP assessments.
